title: Diraq Finalizes $38 Million CHIPS R&D Award with U.S. Department of Commerce for Silicon Spin Quantum Chips
summary:
Diraq secured a $38 million CHIPS R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce to advance silicon spin quantum chips, establishing U.S. facilities and aiming for over two million physical qubits by 2031. This funding will accelerate U.S.-based fabrication, testing, and research for their CMOS-compatible quantum processors.

title: planqc Expands into the UK with Double-Digit Million-Euro Cambridge Optical-Lattice Facility
summary:

summary:

title: Equal1, NVIDIA, and Dell Technologies Demonstrate Real-Time Hybrid Quantum-Classical Rack Integration at SC26
summary:
At SC26, Equal1, NVIDIA, and Dell Technologies showcased a real-time hybrid quantum-classical computing integration. They demonstrated Equal1's RacQ quantum computer integrated with Dell servers in a standard rack. This setup utilizes NVIDIA's software for gate tuning and low-latency communication, with Dell's QIO orchestrating hybrid execution.

title: Classiq Updates Qmod Compiler to Synthesize 2048-Bit Shor’s Algorithm in Under 10 Seconds
summary:
Classiq has upgraded its Qmod quantum programming language and compiler, allowing the Shor's algorithm for a 2048-bit RSA-scale integer to compile in under ten seconds. The improvement addresses a bottleneck in quantum software by preserving classical control structures during synthesis and enabling symbolic indexing of quantum qubit arrays.

title: University of Sussex and Universal Quantum Demonstrate Laser-Free Axial-Mode Entangling Gate on Doppler-Cooled Trapped Ions
summary:
Researchers from the University of Sussex and Universal Quantum have demonstrated a high-fidelity, all-electronic two-qubit entangling gate using Doppler-cooled ytterbium ions. This laser-free gate operates on the axial stretch mode, achieving Bell-state fidelities above fault-tolerant thresholds without ground-state cooling. The innovation offers improved compatibility for quantum computing architectures by simplifying cooling processes and enhancing gate robustness.

title: Quantum eMotion Completes C$32 Million ($22.5 Million USD) Acquisition of Cybersecurity Provider Plurilock Security
summary:

This strategic move combines Quantum eMotion's quantum cryptography with Plurilock's cybersecurity operations, enhancing their offerings in critical services, identity management, and cloud security across North America and NATO. title: European Commission Proposes EU Quantum Act and Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to Scale Industrial Capacity by 2030
summary:
The European Commission has proposed the EU Quantum Act, a legislative framework for quantum technologies, and a €50 billion Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to boost industrial capacity by 2030. This initiative aims to align national and EU programs, address the private growth-capital gap, and establish global industrial leadership in quantum technology. The proposal includes significant funding, research and innovation targets, infrastructure development, and supply chain security measures.

title: IQM Quantum Computers Sells 54-Qubit Radiance R3 System to South Korean Quantum-AI Infrastructure Firm QAI
summary:
IQM Quantum Computers sold a 54-qubit Radiance R3 system to QAI Co., Ltd. in South Korea for EUR 8-10 million. The quantum computer will be installed in QAI's AI data center in Seoul by the end of 2027, making it IQM's first deployment in a private commercial data center in Asia. QAI will offer Quantum-as-a-Service to various organizations, supporting South Korea's national quantum strategy.
